Here are the birth dates of the five authors who most frequently appear on lists of the world’s most‑translated writers (according to sources such as UNESCO’s Index Translationum and the “most‑translated authors” page on Wikipedia):

| Rank | Author | Birth date (day – month – year) |
|------|--------|--------------------------------|
| 1 | **Agatha Christie** (British mystery novelist) | 15 September 1890 |
| 2 | **William Shakespeare** (English playwright & poet) | 23 April 1564* |
| 3 | **Jules Verne** (French science‑fiction novelist) | 8 February 1828 |
| 4 | **Enid Blyton** (British children’s author) | 11 August 1897 |
| 5 | **Harold Robbins** (American thriller novelist) | 21 May 1916 |

\* Shakespeare’s exact birth day is not recorded; the traditional date of 23 April 1564 is derived from his baptism on 26 April 1564 and contemporary customs.
